text_block_list.text:
On the way back home with Nice
Nature...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey... Since we still have some time... do
you want
to go check out some fish?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
The lady at the fish store told me to
bring you
sometime.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Great. Shall we, then?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I follow her, thinking maybe she has her
eye on a
particular fish she wants to buy,
but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, look at them go! These
tasty-looking fish
sure know how to
swim.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: I wasn't expecting to come to an aquarium.

text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Trust me, I get it! You're probably
thinking, "Huh,
what was up with the
way she invited me?" Right?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
That's just good ol' Nature for you. I
can't really
do things the cutesy way.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
After the lady at the fish shop went
through the
trouble of giving me the
tickets for us to relax, I
had to get you
here somehow...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I really didn't mean to trick you or
anything, I
swear.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll be... Who's this cool cucumber
over
here? You sure are taking this in
stride.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Well, that's good. I'm glad you're not
upset.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I don't know if it'll make up for
it, but...
let's see what you want to see
today!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
It looks like they have a lot of
interesting stuff
going on here. Can't go
wrong with everyone's
go-to da—I mean,
hangout spot.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
The jellyfish exhibit, stingrays,
snappers... They
all looked so tasty.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Oh, how about we go and see the
dolphin show?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
...Actually, I bet you don't want to see
cutesy
things like that with me.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll leave it up to you! What do you
want to
go see?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Um... Were you listening?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Okay, I get it, but are you saying that because you want to do it, or...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
No, never mind... I guess I did say we'd
see
whatever you want to see.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Fine. If that'll help you relax, then let's
do it.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I hope you understand I won't be doing
any
cutesy screams, though.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Wow, look at how lively that dolphin is!
Wait...
Water! It's coming this way!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Gyaaaargh!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Drat... That splash was way bigger than I

expected.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I didn't expect the dolphin show to be a

near-death experience...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Geez... Not only did I end up screaming,
it was
more of a yowl.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Heh... I guess it was, wasn't it? Maybe
places like
this are my thing, after all.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Oh, that sounds exciting!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
It says "spookiest." I wonder how scary
these fish
can be...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
We move on to the exhibit area. After
looking
around myself, I glance over at
Nature to see her
reaction.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: So...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: So adooorable!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Awww! Look at their little eyes! And
they're called
flapjack octopi!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Ooh!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
C-come on, this is false advertising! No
way you
could call cuties like this
"spooky."
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Oooh... They're too adorable.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: Hey, that one over there is pretty cute too...

text_block_list.text:
You're right! It's kinda ugly, but in a cute
way!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер and I have a great time at
the
aquarium, and we both leave feeling
fully
refreshed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер and I have a great time at
the
aquarium, and we both leave feeling
fully
refreshed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
